lane:
سذب

سذاب سَذَابٌ , said to be an arabicized word, because [it is asserted that] س and ذ are not combined in any Arabic word; [and if so, سُذْبَةٌ also, men- tioned above, is arabicized;] but in some of the books on plants it is written with the unpointed د; (TA;) _i. q._ فَيْجَنٌ, (K,) which is an ancient Greek word, (TA,) [i. e. πήγανο, meaning _Rue;_] _a well-known_ بَقْل [or _kind of herb_], (K,) _having properties described in the medical books._ (TA.)

سذابى سَذَابِىٌّ _A seller of_ سَذَاب [or _rue_]. (K, * TA.)
